title: Failing test, then a failed switch-on is treated as possibly running
goal: A pump whose switch-on fails is switched off or marked stuck
acceptance: An actuators test, committed failing first: set(true) writes then throws and set(false) throws; afterwards the pump is stuck, no other pump runs and the watchdog retries off
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
